answer_1.quote: The reasoner will use the linearized context perform multi-hop reasoning and obtain the final answer a_final. ... We propose the "Planner-Executor-Reasoner" (PER) architecture ... supporting fine-grained evaluation of both intermediate reasoning steps and final answers.
answer_1.outputs: Generated final answer plus explicit intermediate reasoning steps (sub-questions and step-answers)

answer_2.quote: We adopt the F1 and PSE-G F1 as our evaluation metrics. ... Traditional evaluation metrics for MHQA systems, such as Exact Match (EM) and F1, primarily assess the correctness of the final answer. ... We design a fine-grained evaluation metric, called Plan-aligned Stepwise Evaluation (PSE).

answer_3.quote: Given that powerful LLMs have been proven to have near-human-level performance as judges (Wang et al., 2023), we use powerful LLMs to evaluate the final answers.
methods: LLM-based post-hoc evaluation of final answers
